## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat: New feature
- [ ] fix: Bug fix
- [ ] docs: Documentation only
- [ ] refactor: Internal refactor
- [ ] test: Test changes
- [ ] ci/build/chore: Tooling or infra

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm format:check`

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests where relevant
- [ ] I updated docs where relevant
- [ ] I added a changeset for user-facing changes
- [ ] I confirmed no secrets are committed
